detail.longDescription: 5 months into building Enkihost, a Ruby PaaS, as a solo dev. Some honest numbers and notes: • 0 paying customers so far • every app runs in its own Docker container, orchestrated with Coolify • just implemented horizontal scaling, ready for when the current server fills up Slow, but every week something ships. If you're building something on your own too, how's it going? # BuildInPublic # IndieDev # Ruby # Docker # Coolify
